admission.justification: Realized across mcp/server.py, serving/paseo/provider_limits.py, and serving/paseo/provider_limit_suppressions.py, proven by five unit tests in mcp/tests/test_provider_limit_suppression.py, and required to auto-heal false limits without suppressing genuine limits from pre-limit turns.

applicability: Every MCP tool call handled by AgentsRememberMCP._execute_tool_call on a config-backed server.
conditions: create_server snapshots server._bound_agent_id once from read_agent_binding() (None when unbound or malformed).

AgentsRememberMCP._maybe_suppress_provider_limits offloads suppress_provider_limits_for_live_tool_call via asyncio.to_thread inside suppress(Exception) so limit-file I/O neither blocks the event loop nor fails any tool call.

Auto-suppression selects only mapped live exhausted windows that have an explicit sidecar recordedAt strictly less than a complete host-activity.json entry's eventAt while the seat state is in-turn or permission, re-verified under provider-limits.lock.
exclusions: Unbound servers, malformed bindings, missing or malformed host-activity.json, non-active seat states, legacy limits lacking sidecar recordedAt, and turns with eventAt <= recordedAt fail closed with no suppression.

evidence: mcp/tests/test_provider_limit_suppression.py (causal guard fail-closed matrix, in-turn/permission success, off-loop thread proof, error suppression) on clean tree 54a3d3198b5f47b34a4987cbadf2c9ca58a20a4d

statement: create_server snapshots _bound_agent_id once and AgentsRememberMCP._execute_tool_call offloads a non-blocking, exception-suppressed hook that auto-suppresses mapped live exhausted windows only when recordedAt is explicit in the sidecar and a complete host-activity.json publication shows the seat in-turn or permission with eventAt strictly greater than recordedAt.
title: Bound MCP tool call auto-suppresses only on strict post-limit live turn proof
